items.title: Senior News Anchor / Journalist
items.description: ABBAY TV Ethiopia is seeking an experienced, charismatic Senior News Anchor to lead our prime-time news broadcast. The ideal candidate will have exceptional journalism skills, deep knowledge of Ethiopian and African affairs, and the ability to connect with viewers across the nation and diaspora.
requirements: Minimum 7 years experience in broadcast journalism
Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or related field
Fluent in Amharic and English (Afan Oromo is a plus)
Strong on-camera presence and communication skills
Experience covering politics, economics, and current affairs
Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines
Leadership experience and ability to mentor junior staff
responsibilities: Anchor prime-time news broadcasts (Monday-Friday)
Conduct live and pre-recorded interviews with newsmakers
Collaborate with news producers on story selection and presentation
Represent ABBAY TV at press conferences and events
Mentor junior journalists and reporters
Contribute to special coverage and breaking news situations

items.title: Video Editor / Motion Graphics Designer
items.description: We're looking for a creative and technically skilled Video Editor with motion graphics expertise to join our production team. You'll work on news packages, promotional content, and special programs, helping tell Ethiopian stories with visual excellence.
requirements: 3+ years professional video editing experience
Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects
Experience with DaVinci Resolve for color grading
Strong understanding of storytelling and pacing
Knowledge of Ethiopian visual culture and aesthetics
Ability to work under tight deadlines
Portfolio demonstrating creative and technical skills
responsibilities: Edit daily news packages and segments
Create motion graphics for news and programs
Produce promotional videos and channel trailers
Collaborate with producers and reporters on visual storytelling
Maintain brand consistency across all video content
Archive and organize video assets
benefits: Opportunity to shape Ethiopia's visual media landscape

items.title: Digital Content Manager
items.description: ABBAY TV is expanding its digital presence and seeking a strategic Digital Content Manager to lead our online platforms. You'll develop and execute digital strategy, grow our social media audience, and ensure our content reaches Ethiopians worldwide.
requirements: 5+ years digital media experience
Strong understanding of social media platforms and algorithms
Experience with YouTube channel management and growth
Analytics and data-driven decision making
Content strategy development
Team leadership experience
Knowledge of Ethiopian digital landscape
responsibilities: Develop and execute digital content strategy
Manage social media team and content calendar
Optimize content for different platforms (YouTube, Facebook, Telegram)
Analyze performance metrics and adjust strategy
Grow audience engagement and reach
Coordinate with news and production teams
Stay current with digital trends and platform changes

items.title: Field Reporter / Correspondent - Regional Office
items.description: ABBAY TV is opening a regional bureau in Bahir Dar and seeking a passionate Field Reporter to cover news from the Amhara region. You'll report on politics, culture, development, and human interest stories from one of Ethiopia's most historically significant regions.
requirements: 3+ years journalism experience
Bachelor's in Journalism or related field
Fluent in Amharic (knowledge of local languages a plus)
Strong writing and storytelling skills
Ability to shoot and edit basic video (mobile journalism skills)
Deep knowledge of Amhara region history and current affairs
Willingness to travel extensively within the region
responsibilities: Cover daily news events in Amhara region
Develop story ideas and pitch to editors
Build sources and maintain contacts
Produce video packages for broadcast and digital
Live shots during breaking news
Collaborate with Addis Ababa newsroom

items.title: Marketing and Partnerships Manager
items.description: Drive ABBAY TV's growth through strategic partnerships and marketing initiatives. We're looking for a dynamic professional to build relationships with advertisers, partners, and stakeholders while strengthening our brand presence across Ethiopia and the diaspora.
requirements: 5+ years in marketing, advertising, or business development
Proven track record in partnership building
Strong negotiation and communication skills
Understanding of media industry and advertising landscape
Network of business contacts in Ethiopia
MBA or relevant advanced degree preferred
Fluency in English and Amharic
responsibilities: Develop and execute marketing strategy
Build relationships with potential advertisers and partners
Create sponsorship packages and proposals
Organize promotional events and activations
Collaborate with content team on branded content
Track and report on marketing ROI
Represent ABBAY TV at industry events

items.title: Production Assistant (Entry Level)
items.description: Kickstart your media career with ABBAY TV! We're seeking enthusiastic, motivated Production Assistants to support our news and production teams. This is an excellent opportunity to learn from industry professionals and gain hands-on experience in television production.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in any field (recent graduates encouraged)
Strong interest in media and journalism
Excellent organizational skills
Ability to work flexible hours
Basic computer skills
Eagerness to learn
No prior experience required - we'll train you!
responsibilities: Assist producers and reporters with research
Coordinate logistics for shoots and events
Transcribe interviews
Assist in studio during live broadcasts
Archive and organize media assets
Run errands and provide general support
Learn all aspects of TV production
benefits: Opportunity to work on diverse projects

items.title: Audio Engineer / Sound Designer
items.description: ABBAY TV is building a state-of-the-art audio post-production facility and seeking talented Audio Engineers for freelance and contract work. You'll work on diverse projects including TV programs, commercials, documentaries, and digital content.
requirements: 3+ years audio engineering experience
Proficiency with Pro Tools, Logic Pro, or similar DAWs
Experience with sound design for video
Knowledge of mixing and mastering
Understanding of broadcast audio standards
Own equipment preferred but not required
Portfolio demonstrating audio work
responsibilities: Mix and master audio for TV programs
Create sound design for documentaries and promos
Clean and restore audio from field recordings
Collaborate with video editors and producers
Maintain audio equipment
Meet project deadlines

items.title: Social Media Manager - Diaspora Focus
items.description: Connect ABBAY TV with the Ethiopian diaspora! We're seeking a Social Media Manager based in North America or Europe to grow our international audience and create content specifically for Ethiopians abroad.
requirements: 2+ years social media management experience
Deep understanding of Ethiopian diaspora communities
Experience with Facebook, YouTube, Telegram, TikTok
Content creation skills (graphics, basic video)
Knowledge of social media analytics
Self-motivated and able to work independently
Fluent in English and Amharic
responsibilities: Manage diaspora-focused social media accounts
Create content relevant to Ethiopians abroad
Engage with diaspora community online
Schedule and publish content across time zones
Track and report on engagement metrics
Coordinate with Addis Ababa team
Identify trends and opportunities in diaspora market
